headline: MIL @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.11 at MIN 3.41, with a projected total of 7.51. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIL moved -0.99 runs while MIN moved -0.43, changing the projected margin by -0.56 runs. The projected total fell -1.43, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +8.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Joe Ryan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Austin Martin, Byron Buxton, Brice Turang, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Royce Lewis, Gary Sánchez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
